mapper.update: MERGE INTO INTERF_OPICS_TRAD_REPO T USING (SELECT A.DEALNO as DEALNO, A.PRODUCT as PRODUCT, A.PRODTYPE as PRODTYPE, A.PS as PS, A.COST as COST, A.DEALDATE as DEALDATE, A.VDATE as VDATE, A.MATDATE as MATDATE, A.CCY as CCY, A.REPORATE_8 as REPORATE_8, A.BASIS as BASIS, A.TOTALINT as TOTALINT, A.REPOAMT as REPOAMT, A.REVDATE as REVDATE, A.MATCCYSMEANS as MATCCYSMEANS, A.TRAD as TRAD, A.CNO as CNO, A.CUSTREFNO as CUSTREFNO, A.DEALTEXT as DEALTEXT, A.INPUTDATE as INPUTDATE, A.NOTAMT as NOTAMT FROM SDB_V_RPRH@OPICS A WHERE A.INPUTDATE = #{cDate ,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND TRIM(A.BR) = '06' AND TRIM(A.VERIND) = '1') S ON (T.TRADEID = S.DEALNO) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET T.PRODTYPE = S.PRODUCT, T.PS = (CASE WHEN S.PS = 'P' THEN 'RB' ELSE 'RS' END), T.CRTREVDEALSTATUS = 'N', T.MARKET = 'IB', T.ISMANAUL = 0, T.BUYCOST = S.COST, T.DEALDATE = S.DEALDATE, T.VDATE = S.VDATE, T.MDATE = S.MATDATE, T.TERM = S.MATDATE - S.VDATE, T.CCY = S.CCY, T.REPORATE = S.REPORATE_8, T.BASIS = S.BASIS, T.REPOINTAMT = ABS(S.TOTALINT), T.REPOAMT = ABS(S.REPOAMT), T.VDEALAMT = ABS(S.REPOAMT), T.REVDATE = S.REVDATE, T.VCLRFORM = S.MATCCYSMEANS, T.MCLRFORM = S.MATCCYSMEANS, T.BUYTRADER = S.TRAD, T.SELLER = S.CNO, T.SELLTRADER = S.CUSTREFNO, T.DEALNO = S.DEALNO, T.DEALTEXT = S.DEALTEXT, T.LSTMNTDATE = S.INPUTDATE, T.EFFECTFLAG = #{EFFECTFLAG ,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, T.FACETOTALAMT = S.NOTAMT, T.MDEALAMT = ABS(S.REPOAMT) + ABS(S.TOTALINT) WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (TRADEID, PRODTYPE, PS, CRTREVDEALSTATUS, MARKET, ISMANAUL, BUYCOST, DEALDATE, VDATE, MDATE, TERM, CCY, REPORATE, BASIS, REPOINTAMT, REPOAMT, VDEALAMT, VCLRFORM, MCLRFORM, BUYTRADER, SELLER, SELLTRADER, DEALNO, DEALTEXT, LSTMNTDATE, EFFECTFLAG, FACETOTALAMT, MDEALAMT) VALUES (S.DEALNO, S.PRODUCT, S.PRODTYPE, 'N', 'IB', 0, S.COST, S.DEALDATE, S.VDATE, S.MATDATE, S.MATDATE - S.VDATE, S.CCY, S.REPORATE_8, S.BASIS, ABS(S.TOTALINT), ABS(S.REPOAMT), ABS(S.REPOAMT), S.MATCCYSMEANS, S.MATCCYSMEANS, S.TRAD, S.CNO, S.CUSTREFNO, S.DEALNO, S.DEALTEXT, S.INPUTDATE, #{EFFECTFLAG ,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, S.NOTAMT, ABS(S.REPOAMT) + ABS(S.TOTALINT))

MERGE INTO INTERF_OPICS_TRAD_REPO T USING (SELECT A.REVDATE as REVDATE, A.DEALNO as DEALNO FROM SDB_V_RPRH@OPICS A WHERE A.REVDATE = #{cDate ,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND TRIM(A.BR) = '06') S ON (T.TRADEID = S.DEALNO) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET T.REVDATE = S.REVDATE;

MERGE INTO INTERF_TRAD_REPOASST T USING (SELECT C.DEALNO as DEALNO, C.ASSIGNSEQ as ASSIGNSEQ, C.SECID as SECID, C.FACEAMT as FACEAMT, C.VDCLEANPRICE_8 as VDCLEANPRICE_8, C.MDCLEANPRICE_8 as MDCLEANPRICE_8, C.VDDIRTYPRICE_8 as VDDIRTYPRICE_8, C.MDDIRTYPRICE_8 as MDDIRTYPRICE_8, C.INPUTDATE as INPUTDATE, C.DRPRICE_8 as DRPRICE_8, C.COMMPROCAMT as COMMPROCAMT, fin.SECNAME as SECNAME FROM SDB_V_RPDT@OPICS C LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT fin ON C.SECID = fin.FINPROD_MARKET_ID AND fin.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{type ,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND TRIM(C.BR) = '06') S ON (T.TRADEID = S.DEALNO AND T.SEQNO = S.ASSIGNSEQ) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET T.SECID = S.SECID, T.SECNAME = S.SECNAME, T.FACETOTALAMT = S.FACEAMT, T.CPRICE = S.VDCLEANPRICE_8, T.MCPRICE = S.MDCLEANPRICE_8, T.DPRICE = S.VDDIRTYPRICE_8, T.MDPRICE = S.MDDIRTYPRICE_8, T.LSTMNTDATE = S.INPUTDATE, T.CONVRATE = ABS(S.DRPRICE_8), T.DEALAMT = ABS(S.COMMPROCAMT) WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (TRADEID, SEQNO, SECID, SECNAME, FACETOTALAMT, CPRICE, MCPRICE, DPRICE, MDPRICE, LSTMNTDATE, CONVRATE, DEALAMT) VALUES (S.DEALNO, S.ASSIGNSEQ, S.SECID, S.SECNAME, S.FACEAMT, S.VDCLEANPRICE_8, S.MDCLEANPRICE_8, S.VDDIRTYPRICE_8, S.MDDIRTYPRICE_8, S.INPUTDATE, ABS(S.DRPRICE_8), ABS(S.COMMPROCAMT));
UPDATE INTERF_OPICS_TRAD_REPO OP SET OP.FACETOTALAMT = (SELECT ABS(SUM(TR.FACETOTALAMT)) FACETOTALAMT FROM INTERF_TRAD_REPOASST TR WHERE TRIM(OP.TRADEID) = TR.TRADEID GROUP BY TR.TRADEID)
